slides.title: What is Germany telling Ethiopia about the Horn?
"A stable Ethiopia is vital to the region"
slides.body: German Foreign Minister Wadephul, per a ministry readout of a call with Ethiopia's foreign minister.

slides.title: "Any escalation must be avoided"
slides.body: Germany says it backs efforts for stability in northern Ethiopia.
